label: Ancestry-rooted reconcile classification (BL-621 lifetime fix)
summary: Replaced token-based reap verdict in classifyReconcileTargets with ancestry-rooted classification: a process is reapable only if its kernel parentage chain reaches no live tracked-instance root and no live writer-socket holder. memory-server's enrich-isolation/fastembed fork children now survive doctor --reconcile; BL-170 orphans still reap.

handoff_notes: classifyReconcileTargets now REQUIRES a processTable arg — any future caller must pass snapshotProcessTable().
descendantOf walks the pid's ppid chain (starts at the parent, not the pid itself); the caller's rule 1/2 handle a pid that IS itself a root.
ReconcileHealMarker is a discriminated union {singleton-duplicate|zombie-reap|descendant-skip}; cmdService status only surfaces the singleton-duplicate variant (BL-393).

doctor-reconcile.spec.ts integration test drives real processes (backend socket holder + fork child + reparented orphan) — requires a health-socket endpoint in the fixture manifest and an install-registry.json entry (not extensions.lock).
